data.long_meaning: AlJabar is derived from the Arabic word 'Jabr' which means 'compulsion', 'necessity', or 'decree'. This name is often given to remind us of Allah's ultimate power and control over our lives. The name AlJabar carries the meaning “The Compeller” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose AlJabar usually hope their child will grow to embody the compeller and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_arabic.name: الجبار
in_arabic.long_meaning: الجبار هو اسم يدل على القوة والشدة، ومصدره الجبر الذي يعني إزالة العظم والقوة، ويستخدم في القرآن الكريم لوصف الله تعالى بالجبار، ويعتبر هذا الاسم ممتازا في الثقافة الإسلامية لما يحمله من معاني القوة والسيطرة

in_urdu.name: الجبار
